title: Metrics and execution
summary: A key metric moved. Structure the investigation and say what you would check first.

phases.title: Clarify
phases.goal: Open in about twenty words: first name, round and length, the metric change in short, then ask where they would start[[tool: , and call show_question]]. Answer clarifying questions with the facts.

phases.title: Hypotheses
phases.goal: Let them structure: data checks, internal versus external, segments, funnel step. Give data exactly when asked. If they jump to one cause, ask what else could explain it.

phases.title: First checks
phases.goal: Ask what they would check first and why that before the rest. Close[[tool:  and call end_round]].
